findings.message: INI directive 'safe_mode' is deprecated since PHP 5.3 and removed since PHP 5.4 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like debug_backtrace(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$args" was changed on line 82. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)

When the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods are available and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the implementation of the Serializable interface can be removed. (the class also has __serialize()/__unserialize(), so PHP does not emit the Serializable deprecation)
Function utf8_encode() is deprecated since PHP 8.2; Use mb_convert_encoding(), UConverter::transcode() or iconv instead
